label: Actual concordance between veterans' with Gulf War Illness and their providers' illness perceptions is not related to patient satisfaction nor treatment adherence.
summary: Patients with persistent physical symptom (PPS) conditions, such as Gulf War Illness (GWI), report disagreement or "non-concordance" with their providers about PPS conditions and dissatisfaction with healthcare. When patients perceive concordance with their providers about their PPS condition, they have increased satisfaction and adherence.
